evidence.observation: Single-sample dip to 54.4 sccm with matching pressure dip (2.574 Torr) at k=5, recovered fully at k=6
Growth held at 750°C within ~1°C after initial settle; cooldown proceeding with heater at 0%
Exhaust O2 stable 4-7 ppm throughout, no leak signature

args.missing_evidence: Post-growth characterization (e.g., Raman/optical) of the sample; confirmation that the one-sample Ar/pressure dip was a telemetry glitch rather than a real transient flow interruption.
